implementation_notes: Attempt 02 contains a full candidate patch of new T04 files, based on current root where these application/security/observability/configuration target files are absent; it is not a delta against attempt 01.
MockEffectFactory strategies now produce serialized payload strings; only create wraps each once in its OutboxMessage.

TraceContextFilter uses active Micrometer tracing context or creates a real span when absent; it exports trace/span IDs via request attributes and response headers and logs safe method/path/status/duration metadata without query strings or credentials. Security errors read the generated trace attribute.

Terminal fact mutation denial is based on the configured engine returning no outgoing options. System transition behavior is left to configured engine roles; T05 must protect /api/system/** and block system credentials on public transition routes.

Fact edit lifecycle policy remains documented in code: clerk SUBMITTED/PENDING_INFO; lead DOCUMENTS_VERIFIED; assessor UNDER_ASSESSMENT; finance PAYMENT_INITIATED with real request/reference; member acknowledgment on own REJECTED claim.
Clock uses Clock.tick(Clock.systemUTC(), 1 microsecond); retry schedule uses existing claims.outbox-retry-delay-ms property.
Added regression coverage for strategy payloads, empty fact patches, oversized/NUL inputs, and config-derived terminal behavior.
